title: Senior/Principal .NET Developer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for passionate and creative engineers who are eager to build innovative products and embrace new technologies at a leading hedge fund. You will be part of a small, agile, and highly skilled team of technologists building next‑generation platforms to optimize investment decisions.


Responsibilities:

As a Frameworks Developer, you will play a key role in building and evolving the firm’s core application framework used by development teams across the organization. This is a highly collaborative, hands‑on role with broad impact.


Key responsibilities:

- Plan, develop, and support the firm’s in‑house application framework

- Define and contribute to low‑level architecture and core design decisions

- Partner with development teams to help kickstart new projects and provide technical expertise

- Collaborate with developers and business users across the organization to deliver mission‑critical platforms and services

- Support investment professionals across equities, credit, and other major asset classes

- Work closely with the broader Technology team on cross‑functional initiatives


Mandatory Skills Description:

- At least 8 years of professional software development experience

Deep expertise in

- C#,

- ASP.NET,

- SQL Server

- Good working knowledge of Angular, JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML, CSS

- Full SDLC experience: requirements, implementation, testing, release, and support

- Strong focus on clean, high‑performance code (SOLID principles)

- Experience with multi‑threaded programming

- Proven ability to build scalable, high‑availability applications and support production systems

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, including technical discussions

- Strong team‑oriented, collaborative working style

- Independent, proactive mindset with a high level of ownership and collaboration


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- CI/CD systems (TeamCity, Octopus Deploy)

- Financial products (equities, derivatives, fixed income, etc. and related terminology)

- Order management systems (i.e., Charles River)

- Working with market data (i.e., Bloomberg Terminal, Bloomberg APIs)

- Workload automation and enterprise job scheduling software (i.e., ActiveBatch)

- Profiling and performance tuning techniques throughout the whole stack


Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Lead QA Engineer - AI/ML
description:
Job Title: Lead QA Engineer - AI/ML

Location: Remote (Brazil/Mexico)

Contract


About Smart IT Frame:

At Smart IT Frame, we connect top talent with leading organizations across the USA. With over a decade of staffing excellence, we specialize in IT, healthcare, and professional roles, empowering both clients and candidates to grow together.


Role Overview

  • We are seeking a highly skilled, forward-thinking Lead QA Engineer to drive our quality strategy, with a strong emphasis on test automation and AI-driven testing solutions.
  • This role combines leadership, technical expertise, and innovation to deliver high-quality software at scale.
  • You will lead QA initiatives, mentor a team of engineers, and champion modern approaches to quality engineering, including machine learning and AI-assisted testing—while maintaining deep expertise in manual and blackbox testing practices.


Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy

  • Define and implement the QA strategy with a focus on automation-first and AI-enhanced testing.
  • Lead and mentor a team of QA engineers across both manual and automation disciplines.
  • Establish best practices, standards, and KPIs for quality engineering.

Automation Excellence

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks.
  • Drive adoption of CI/CD-integrated testing pipelines.
  • Ensure high test coverage across:
  • UI
  • API
  • Performance
  • Security layers

AI-Driven Testing

  • Evaluate and implement AI/ML tools for:
  • Test generation
  • Maintenance
  • Defect prediction
  • Leverage AI for:
  • Intelligent test case prioritization
  • Self-healing test scripts
  • Stay up to date with emerging AI technologies and integrate them into QA workflows.

Manual & Blackbox Testing Leadership

  • Define and oversee comprehensive blackbox testing strategies, including:
  • Exploratory testing
  • Usability testing
  • Regression testing
  • End-to-end testing
  • Ensure thorough validation of business requirements and user flows without reliance on internal code knowledge.
  • Lead complex manual testing efforts for new features, edge cases, and high-risk areas.
  • Establish best practices for:
  • Test case design
  • Test data management
  • Defect reporting

Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to embed quality throughout the SDLC.
  • Participate in architecture and design discussions to ensure testability and scalability.

Quality Advocacy

  • Promote a culture of quality ownership across teams.
  • Conduct risk assessments and ensure timely defect resolution.


Required Qualifications

  • Strong expertise in both automated and manual (blackbox) testing methodologies.
  • Proven experience designing and executing:
  • Detailed manual test plans
  • Exploratory testing
  • End-to-end validation
  • Deep understanding of blackbox testing techniques, including:
  • Equivalence partitioning
  • Boundary value analysis
  • User-centric validation
  • Strong expertise in test automation frameworks:
  • Selenium
  • Playwright
  • Cypress
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language:
  • Python
  • Java
  • JavaScript / TypeScript (preferably)
  • Experience with CI/CD tools:
  • Jenkins
  • GitHub Actions
  • GitLab CI
  • Solid understanding of software testing methodologies and SDLC.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML tools in QA (e.g., test generation, visual testing, anomaly detection).
  • Familiarity with AI-powered testing platforms or frameworks.
  • Experience balancing manual exploratory testing with automation strategies in complex systems.
  • Experience with performance testing tools:
  • JMeter
  • k6
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms:
  • AWS
  • GCP
  • Azure
  • Experience with containerization:
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes


Key Skills

  • Leadership and team development
  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving
  • Strong communication and collaboration
  • Innovation mindset with a passion for AI in testing
  • Strong analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to deeply understand user behavior through manual testing approaches


Apply today or share profiles at

title: Python Developer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Python Developer para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas brasileiros. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter web crawlers e scrapers
  • Identificar e resolver problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade com crawling distribuído em escala.
  • Escrever códigos limpos, de alta qualidade e fácil manutenção seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de produto, design e operações para definir requisitos e entregar soluções eficazes;
  • Participar ativamente em discussões de arquitetura e tecnologias;
  • Realizar code reviews, ajudando outros desenvolvedores a melhorar a qualidade do código;
  • Garantir que a documentação do código e arquitetura esteja sempre atualizada.


Requisitos:

  • Sólida experiência com Python 3;
  • Conhecimentos protocolos web, como HTTP/HTTPS;
  • Experiência prática com scraping e crawling (ex: requests, BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, etc.);
  • Experiência com HTML e JavaScript;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais;
  • Orquestração de containers (Docker e docker-compose);
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git;
  • Conhecimento de cloud AWS.
  • Boa habilidade de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico;


Desejável:

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Prática em Domain-Driven Design (DDD) e Clean Architecture;
  • Conhecimento de Redes de computadores;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de CI/CD utilizando github actions;
  • Experiência em times de desenvolvimento de software ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e ferramentas de integração contínua;
  • Conhecimento de Design Patterns;


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa desenvolvedora e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se aplique na vaga!

title: Reconciliation Systems Architect (IntelliMatch DIM)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced IntelliMatch (DIM) Solution Architect to lead the design, development, and evolution of our reconciliation platform. This role combines architectural ownership with hands-on technical expertise , playing a key role in delivering scalable and efficient reconciliation solutions across global banking systems.

You will act as a technical authority , guiding development, support, and functional teams while ensuring best practices, performance, and architectural integrity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own end-to-end architecture for IntelliMatch (DIM) solutions
  • Lead hands-on development , including configurations, enhancements, and automation
  • Design and implement SQL-based reconciliation logic and workflows
  • Establish and enforce technical standards and best practices
  • Drive integration strategies between IntelliMatch and upstream/downstream systems
  • Act as technical lead during delivery , ensuring quality across implementation, testing, and release
  • Collaborate with stakeholders on backlog prioritization and solution planning
  • Analyze existing systems to identify performance and architectural improvements
  • Maintain detailed architecture documentation and design artifacts

✅ Must-Have (Non-Negotiable Skills)

  • ✔ IntelliMatch (DIM) experience (Version 20+)
  • ✔ Strong hands-on experience in IntelliMatch architecture & development
  • ✔ Advanced SQL / MS SQL Server expertise
  • ✔ Experience in reconciliation / financial systems
  • ✔ Ability to work hands-on + architect-level

⭐ Good to Have

  • Experience with PowerShell / Python scripting
  • Exposure to Azure / cloud platforms
  • Experience with JIRA / Agile methodologies
  • Banking or financial services domain experience

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT / Computer Science / Software Engineering
  • 10+ years of experience in IntelliMatch (DIM) or similar reconciliation platforms
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

title: Senior Data Scientist/AI Engineer
description:
Role Overview

KPIT is seeking a highly skilled, hands-on Senior Data Scientist / AI Engineer (Remote) to architect, develop, and deliver end-to-end Machine Learning and AI solutions within the Azure ecosystem.


The successful candidate will be responsible for the entire AI lifecycle—from designing scalable data pipelines to deploying production-grade AI agents capable of complex, multi-step reasoning. This role is ideal for an engineer who excels at bridging the gap between experimental data science and robust, scalable MLOps.


Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Solution Delivery: Own the full lifecycle of AI/ML solutions, from initial problem definition and data acquisition to production deployment and monitoring.
  • Data Engineering & Pipeline Development: Build and maintain high-performance, scalable data pipelines using PySpark and Spark on Azure Databricks.
  • Model Development & Feature Engineering: Perform advanced feature engineering, data preparation, and sophisticated model development for diverse business use cases.
  • Agentic AI & GenAI: Develop and deploy AI agents and workflows utilizing multi-step reasoning, tool usage, and Generative AI frameworks.
  • MLOps & Lifecycle Management: Implement and manage MLflow for experiment tracking; monitor model performance, data drift, and system reliability in production environments.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Business, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams to translate business requirements into technical AI solutions.
  • Technical Leadership: Act as a subject matter expert, mentoring junior team members and driving engineering best practices.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Programming & Data: Expert-level proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Big Data & Cloud: Strong hands-on experience with PySpark, Apache Spark, and Azure Databricks.
  • Machine Learning: Deep understanding of ML workflows, model evaluation techniques, and statistical modeling.
  • MLOps: Practical experience with MLflow and fundamental MLOps principles (CI/CD for ML, model versioning, and monitoring).
  • Generative AI: Proven exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or AutoGen).
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.


Experience Requirements

  • Professional Experience: 5–6 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering.
  • Production Experience: A proven track record of deploying and maintaining ML/AI models in a production environment.
  • Cloud Expertise: Extensive experience working within cloud environments, specifically Microsoft Azure.


About KPIT

KPIT is a global partner to the automotive and mobility ecosystem. We deliver end-to-end engineering, data, and AI-led digital transformation solutions to leading Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and Tier-1 suppliers worldwide, shaping the future of mobility.

title: Senior Base24 Software Developer
description:
Job Title: Base24 EPS Software Developer

Modelo de contratação:PJ

Requisito obrigatório: PJ (necessário CNPJ ativo) CNPJ ativo

Local: Remoto

Início: Imediato

Nível: Sênior

Years of Experience: 5 7 Years

Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled Base24 EPS Software Developer with a strong background in Base24 architecture and modules, as well as expertise in Base24. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of ATM and POS authorization principles, along with operational knowledge of the WebGate product. This role requires a proactive individual who can navigate complex systems, provide technical expertise, and collaborate effectively with business partners and external vendors.

Responsibilities:

  • Navigate through Base24 configuration structure using UI client.
  • Provide technical expertise to business partners, explaining system potential for future expansion or improvements.
  • Work closely with external vendors to coordinate troubleshooting and issue resolution across different platforms.
  • Maintain productive relationships with internal and external groups and organizations.
  • Understand business needs driving projects or system changes.
  • Act as the custodian and technical owner of Base24 installations.
  • Monitor system health, suggest improvements to streamline operations, and provide technical advice.
  • Lead the resolution of production problems in a critical manner.

Mandatory Skills:

  • Base24 EPS architecture and modules structure
  • Base24 EPS scripting
  • Base24 Classic architecture
  • ATM and POS authorization principles
  • Operational knowledge of WebGate product
  • Network protocols TCP/IP
  • NonStop Batchcom, SCF, FUP, TACL, EMS commands and navigation
  • ACI NCPCOM utility purpose, commands, and operational principles
  • Base24 XPNET networking configuration
  • C Programming
  • TACL macros and script writing skills
  • Stored Procedure
  • EMV, card verification, PIN security concepts

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with system health monitoring tools
  • Knowledge of software development best practices
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5 7 years of relevant experience in software development, specifically with Base24 systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • If you are a motivated individual with a passion for technology and a desire to contribute to innovative projects, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity

title: .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: .NET Developer

Location: Remote (Brazil-based only)

Salary: $3,500-4,500 per month

Job Type: Contract

Experience Level: Senior Level


About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled .NET Developer to join our growing development team. This fully remote role is open to candidates based in Brazil and offers the opportunity to work on modern application development projects in a supportive and agile environment.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions using .NET / .NET Core , SQL , and AWS technologies. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and a strong understanding of application development lifecycle is essential.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications using .NET/.NET Core and related technologies
  • Work with SQL databases to design schemas, write queries, and optimize performance
  • Develop and maintain cloud-based applications using AWS
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for streamlined deployment processes
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application issues in a timely manner
  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following best practices

title: Product Owner
description:
Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Senior Software Engineer com forte experiência em Python/FastAPI para liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de novas features, integrações e a evolução arquitetural da nossa plataforma.

Esperamos alguém que tome decisões arquiteturais, defina padrões para o time, mentore engenheiros menos sêniores e trabalhe lado a lado com fundadores e CTO em decisões de produto e infraestrutura.


Sobre a empresa

Somos uma startup de Agentic AI atuando no varejo enterprise no Brasil. Construímos agentes que operam 24/7 em produção, processando volume relevante para grandes redes. Estamos em fase de escala — cada decisão arquitetural tomada hoje impacta nossa capacidade de crescer nos próximos 18-24 meses.


Mais detalhes sobre clientes, parcerias e roadmap são compartilhados durante o processo seletivo, essa é uma oportunidade de trabalhar com IA para as maiores empresa do Brasil.


Responsabilidades


  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução do backend da plataforma
  • Desenhar e implementar sistemas distribuídos escaláveis em produção
  • Arquitetar integrações críticas com sistemas de terceiros
  • Definir padrões de código, testes e observabilidade do time
  • Mentorar engenheiros pleno e júnior, elevando a barra técnica
  • Trabalhar com CTO e fundadores em decisões arquiteturais de longo prazo
  • Garantir confiabilidade, performance e segurança de sistemas transacionais



Stack


  • Linguagem: Python
  • Framework: FastAPI
  • Infraestrutura: Google Cloud Platform
  • Banco de dados: PostgreSQL
  • Práticas: observabilidade ponta a ponta, CI/CD, evals para sistemas não-determinísticos



Perfil Ideal


  • 6+ anos construindo backends em produção, sendo pelo menos 2 como referência técnica de um time
  • Domínio sólido de Python e frameworks assíncronos (FastAPI, asyncio)
  • Experiência desenhando arquiteturas escaláveis e sistemas distribuídos (microsserviços, filas, eventos)
  • Forte experiência com Google Cloud Platform (ou equivalente em AWS/Azure)
  • Conhecimento profundo em autenticação (OAuth2, JWT, SSO) e SQL avançado
  • Experiência integrando APIs externas complexas em produção (webhooks, rate limits, retries, idempotência)
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas com tradeoffs claros e comunicá-las ao time



Diferenciais


  • Experiência construindo features com LLMs em produção (orquestração de agentes, tool use, evals)
  • Experiência em fintech, varejo ou marketplaces
  • Experiência prévia em startup early-stage



Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto
  • Contrato PJ
  • Remuneração competitiva

title: UX Designer - Remoto (Afirmativa PCD)
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: UX Designer - Remoto (Afirmativa PCD)


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Acesso a plataforma de apoio psicossocial

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação em projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência com UX/UI Design (Prototipação);
  • Experiência com rotinas da área de UX Writer;
  • Conhecimento sobre experiência do usuário e teste de usabilidade;
  • Vivência com UX Research.


Formação: superior completo ou cursando na área de TI.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
The client is looking to build and scale advanced AI-powered solutions leveraging Generative AI technologies. The project focuses on designing and implementing intelligent systems using LLMs and agentic workflows to enhance business processes and deliver high-impact, scalable products.


General information

They are seeking a senior-level AI Engineer with strong experience in Generative AI and system architecture. The ideal candidate will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying scalable GenAI solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and multi-agent architectures.

This role requires both hands-on technical expertise and the ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and business stakeholders.


Task and Deliverables

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Design and implement GenAI-based systems (LLMs, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, fine-tuning)
  • Build and orchestrate agentic workflows, including multi-agent systems and tool integrations
  • Develop scalable APIs and microservices to support AI-driven applications
  • Contribute to overall system architecture, including cloud-based integrations (AWS and/or Azure)
  • Establish evaluation frameworks to measure performance (accuracy, latency, cost)
  • Continuously optimize models and systems through feedback loops and iteration
  • Provide regular updates to stakeholders on progress, risks, and deliverables


Required Experience

  • Proven hands-on experience with Generative AI technologies (LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering)
  • Solid understanding of AI system architecture and cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure)
  • Working knowledge of Python and relevant AI/ML frameworks
  • Experience with API integration, microservices, and scalable system design
  • Strong communication skills and experience working with global stakeholders


Highlights

  • Long term (12+ monthts)
  • 40 hrs/week

title: Bilingual Receptionist
description:
Company Description


CatalyzeX is a leading outsourcing partner specializing in delivering cost-effective, highly efficient labor solutions for businesses across various industries. We help companies grow by delivering top-tier talent and support.


Role Description


We are seeking a highly professional and empathetic Paralegal Receptionist  to support a legal team remotely. The ideal candidate will be fluent in Spanish and English , with Portuguese as a strong preference , and will serve as the first point of contact for clients, ensuring a smooth intake and client communication experience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer and route high volumes of incoming calls in Spanish and English with professionalism and empathy
  • Take detailed messages and leave accurate notes for attorney/client callbacks
  • Manage front desk operations, including greeting walk-ins and handling inquiries
  • Provide support during high-traffic periods and maintain a calm, composed demeanor with frustrated or emotional clients (usually during the intake process).
  • Collaborate with legal assistants and attorneys to ensure timely follow-ups
  • Assist with administrative duties such as fax assignments and scheduling meetings
  • Coordinate with colleagues to ensure coverage at the front desk
  • Maintain confidentiality and professionalism in all interactions


Qualifications

  • Strong American accent with excellent English communication skills (spoken and written)
  • Bilingual (Spanish and English) is required; Portuguese proficiency is preferred
  • Candidates with trilingual proficiency (Spanish, English, and Portuguese)  are highly encouraged to apply
  • Must be based in Brazil, Colombia, or anywhere in Latin America
  • Knowledge of legal procedures, case management, and document handling is a plus
  • Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Proficiency with legal case management software is a plus
  • Ability to thrive both independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment
  • Background in workers' compensation required
  • Background in personal injury law is a plus


Compensation:  $6 to $7 per hour (Negotiable DOE)


Working Hours:  Eastern or Pacific Time Zone


If you're ready to make a meaningful impact and become a key member of our team, we'd love to hear from you .


Apply Here:

title: DevOps - Remoto (Afirmativa PCD)
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: DevOps - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação em projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

Obrigatório

  • Conhecimentos básicos em Linux (terminal, análise de logs e processos)
  • Lógica de programação e/ou scripting (Python, Bash ou similar)
  • Noções de Git (clone, commit, pull request)
  • Conceitos iniciais de automação e infraestrutura como código
  • Conhecimento conceitual sobre containers e Kubernetes/OpenShift
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de arquivos YAML





O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Product / Marketing Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Product/Marketing Analyst to work on configuring and managing offers and partners within our PRM (Partner Relationship Management) system, ensuring the efficient execution of initiatives requested by the operator Vivo and coordinating activities with internal departments.


RESPONSIBILITIES:


· Configure offers and partners in the PRM system.


· Receive, analyze, and manage requests for new initiatives (new offers, changes, or the addition of new partners) from Vivo.


· Create status presentations and reports to track the initiatives.


· Coordinate with internal departments such as Development, Support, and QA as needed.


· Perform functional testing of offers prior to launch, ensuring quality and compliance.


· Support communication and alignment with internal and external stakeholders.


REQUIREMENTS:


· Experience in digital product management or product marketing.


· Knowledge of partner management platforms or CRM.


· Ability to create clear and objective presentations and reports.


· Ability to coordinate between technical and business departments.


· Organization and attention to detail to ensure quality in deliverables.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:


· Experience in the telecom sector or with B2B2C platforms.


· Familiarity with partner integration processes and offer configuration.


· Basic knowledge of functional testing and QA tools.


· Fluency in Spanish.



ABOUT THE COMPANY:


TIMWETECH, a Portuguese multinational, is a global provider of technology solutions, operating in 80 countries through 30 offices and serving our clients with a diverse portfolio organized into three vertical sectors: B2B2C Platform Services, Digital Marketing, and Fintech.

title: Consultor SAP Sênior FSM SAP (Field Service Management)
description:
Consultor SAP FSM (Projeto Global | Suporte e Evolução)


Estamos com uma oportunidade para Consultor SAP FSM, com atuação em projeto global de suporte e evolução contínua da solução, em uma empresa de grande porte.


Formato de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Modelo de contrato: PJ

Duração: 1 ano

Idioma: Inglês avançado (atuação com time internacional – fuso Califórnia/PST)


O que buscamos:

  • Experiência sólida com SAP FSM (SAP Field Service Management)
  • +5 anos de experiência com SAP FSM e S/4HANA
  • Participação em pelo menos 3 projetos completos de implementação SAP FSM
  • Experiência com suporte nível 2 e 3 (AMS) e resolução de incidentes
  • Atuação em projetos globais ou ambientes internacionais
  • Experiência com:
  • Configuração, customização e testes da solução
  • Análise e resolução de tickets (JIRA, ServiceNow)
  • Suporte a usuários e testes (UAT)
  • Levantamento e implementação de melhorias contínuas
  • Conhecimento em integrações com sistemas terceiros (SAP ERP, entre outros)
  • Experiência com extensibilidade no FSM (campos customizados, regras de negócio, APIs)
  • Vivência com documentação funcional e técnica


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com SAP BTP, APIs REST e soluções cloud
  • Integração com SAP EAM ou S/4HANA
  • Conhecimento em SAP Fiori, UI5 ou aplicações mobile FSM

Estamos com uma oportunidade para Consultor SAP FSM, com atuação em projeto global de suporte e evolução contínua da solução, em uma empresa de grande porte.


Formato de trabalho: 100% Remoto

  • Configuração, customização e testes da solução
  • Análise e resolução de tickets (JIRA, ServiceNow)
  • Suporte a usuários e testes (UAT)

  • Experiência com extensibilidade no FSM (campos customizados, regras de negócio, APIs)
  • Vivência com documentação funcional e técnica


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com SAP BTP, APIs REST e soluções cloud
  • Integração com SAP EAM ou S/4HANA
  • Conhecimento em SAP Fiori, UI5 ou aplicações mobile FSM

title: Server Manager (Global Project)
description:
Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional altamente qualificado(a) para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Nesta função, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.


Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos, solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos

  • Expertise em Linux: Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu. É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA: Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial.
  • Proficiencia em Nuvem: Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF.
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível.


Quem Somos

Talento onde você precisa, quando você precisa! A SGF Global é uma provedora líder de soluções especializadas em talentos, dedicada a conectar profissionais altamente qualificados com oportunidades em diversos setores. Oferecemos soluções de contratação para posições temporárias, permanentes e de contrato para efetivação em áreas como tecnologia, finanças e contabilidade, engenharia, marketing e criação, serviços jurídicos, suporte administrativo e ao cliente, energia, petróleo e gás, telecomunicações, manufatura, aeroespacial, ciências da vida, mineração e utilidades. Na SGF Global, trabalhamos para colocá-lo na melhor posição para ter sucesso. Oferecemos acesso a posições de alto nível, remuneração competitiva, benefícios atrativos e treinamentos online gratuitos. Fique por dentro de todas as oportunidades, a qualquer momento — mesmo em movimento.

title: Senior Application Development Consultant
description:
Job Title :: Senior Application Development Consultant

Location :: Brazil Remote

Job Type :: Contract

Language Requirement: English & Portuguese are a must, Spanish is desirable

Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Application Development Consultant with extensive experience in application development, DevOps practices, and application architecture. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in utilizing the Agent Development Kit (ADK) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to deliver innovative solutions. This role requires a strategic thinker who can effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project success.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the design, development, and implementation of application solutions using best practices in application development.

• Collaborate with DevOps teams to streamline deployment processes and enhance application performance.

• Utilize the Agent Development Kit (ADK) to create robust applications that meet client requirements.

• Architect scalable and efficient application solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers and team members.

• Engage with clients to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

• Ensure adherence to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining high-quality standards.

Mandatory Skills:

• Proven experience in application development with a strong portfolio of completed projects.

• Expertise in DevOps methodologies and tools.

• Proficient in using the Agent Development Kit (ADK).

• Strong understanding of application architecture principles.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and deployment.

Preferred Skills:

• Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

• Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.

• Experience in Agile project management methodologies.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 7-10 years of relevant experience in application development and consultancy.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

title: [Serviços] Analista Sênior de Serviços (Serviços de IA)
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções robustas, escaláveis e de alto impacto. Você terá papel estratégico nas decisões técnicas, colaborando com o time para construir produtos de qualidade e orientar outros desenvolvedores(as).


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de software escaláveis e de alta performance
  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura das aplicações, garantindo boas práticas e padrões de mercado
  • Escrever código limpo, testável e de fácil manutenção
  • Realizar code reviews, assegurando qualidade, segurança e padronização do código
  • Atuar na identificação e resolução de problemas técnicos complexos
  • Participar de decisões técnicas estratégicas junto ao time
  • Implementar e manter testes automatizados (unitários, integração e/ou end-to-end)
  • Apoiar a integração contínua, deploy e monitoramento das aplicações
  • Garantir boas práticas de versionamento, documentação e observabilidade


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas - obrigatório;
  • Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior ou em posição equivalente
  • Domínio nas linguagens (Python, JavaScript)
  • Experiência prática com frameworks (LangChain) e bibliotecas modernas
  • Experiência com arquitetura de APIs, microsserviços e integração com sistemas diversos;
  • Conhecimento sólido em bancos de dados relacionais e/ou NoSQL;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas e serviços de nuvem (OCI ou GCP);
  • Experiência com controle de versão (Git)
  • Vivência com testes automatizados e boas práticas de qualidade de código
  • Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas/plataformas (Machine Learning, IA Generativa, LLM, GPT ou Gemini);
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de NLP (Processamento de Linguagem Natural) e Computer Vision, quando aplicável;


SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:

  • Conhecimento em extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL) aplicados a pipelines de IA - desejável.
  • Cursos profissionais (IA) - diferencial.
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização na área de tecnologia será considerada um diferencial


Benefícios

  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP
description:
Make this the place where you grow!


Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas,


Com operações em mais de 30 países e reunindo 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 países, permitimos que milhares de empresas se tornassem mais eficientes e eficazes nas últimas três décadas.

Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DATA faz parte do Grupo NTT.


Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede. Make this the place where you grow!


Estamos em busca de um Consultor Desenvolvedor ABAP com experiência em Desenvolvimento e Depuração para integrar nossa equipe de AMS. O profissional será responsável por fazer análise dos processos desenvolvidos, encontrando falhas e propondo ajustes, desenvolver e manter soluções SAP avançadas, técnicas e garantindo a entrega de alta qualidade. Atendo diversos clientes de diversos setores, inclusive para atendimento de clientes internacionais.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Conhecimento avançado em Depuração objetos Standards e Desenvolvidos - Desenvolver e manter programas complexos em ABAP para atender às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Realizar análise de requisitos e documentação técnica detalhada.

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Client Success Manager with 4+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.


Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 4+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting New Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Company: Hirebus

Location: Remote in Brazil

Pay: $30K-$60K per year


We're hiring a mid-level engineer to own two things: the quality of our codebase and the early foundations of our AI agent work.


The role

Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


Technical Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience with a track record of shipping production SaaS products
  • Expert in Node.js, React, and TypeScript with strong product architecture instincts (scalability, maintainability, speed of iteration)
  • Hands-on Supabase experience: Postgres schema design, RLS policies, edge functions, and auth
  • Shipped production LLM-powered features (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) with a working understanding of prompt engineering, evals, latency/cost tradeoffs, and guardrails
  • Experience building agentic workflows, RAG systems, or tool-use integrations (MCP, function calling)
  • Excellent written English and self-directed async work style, with meaningful overlap with US Mountain Time
  • Comfortable using AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow


Your first 90 days:

  • Month 1: You've shipped real bug fixes. You're in the PR review rotation and contributing useful feedback. You have context on the parts of the system that break most often.
  • Month 2: Test coverage in your area has improved measurably. You've identified at least one chunk of tech debt worth prioritizing and started on it.
  • Month 3: You've shipped a meaningful refactor. You've made your first contributions to the AI agent infrastructure — something concrete, with results we can point to.


We're not looking for someone who wants to rewrite everything from scratch. We want someone who makes the team steadily better — through reliable fixes, honest reviews, and the kind of infrastructure work that compounds over time. If you're also curious about what engineering looks like as AI agents become part of the workflow, even better.

title: Marketing AI Agent Builder
description:
Role Overview:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Core Responsibilities:

• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.

• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.

• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.

• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.

• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market SaaS revenue engine.

• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude CoWork, CodeX)

• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI).

• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.

• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.

• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Backend Developer Or Kotlin Backend Developer
  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop backend services using Kotlin
  • Build and maintain real-time data pipelines for inventory, pricing, orders, and customer activity
  • Implement event-driven systems using Kafka
  • Develop and optimize search and catalog capabilities using Elasticsearch
  • Ensure system scalability, performance, and high availability
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions
  • Contribute to architecture decisions for omnichannel retail platforms

Required Skills

  • Strong backend development experience with Kotlin , 5+ years of experience
  • Experience with Kafka for event streaming
  • Hands-on experience with Elasticsearch
  • Experience building data pipelines and distributed systems
  • Solid understanding of microservices and API design

title: GHL Support + Junior Developer
description:
Company Description

Fabri Holdings is a forward-thinking company focused on consulting other companies to help them grow and scale til their full potential is reached. To help us, we're now looking for a Developer + AI Support Specialist that can help our clients grow with our help.


Role Description

The role involves designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions, providing technical support for AI-driven systems, and troubleshooting issues. The individual will also collaborate with cross-functional teams to address technical challenges, enhance existing systems, and ensure optimal system functionality. Strong analytical capabilities and effective communication will be critical in delivering seamless solutions.


Qualifications

  • GHL: sub-accounts, custom fields, pipelines, calendars, conversations
  • Workflows & automations, Custom Code Action (JS), webhooks
  • E-commerce in GHL: products, order forms, payment gateways (Stripe)
  • Funnels, Page Builder
  • Snapshots: create, load, update
  • Affiliate Manager: campaigns, commissions, payouts
  • A2P 10DLC & Toll-Free submission and troubleshooting
  • GHL API v2: OAuth, webhooks, rate limits
  • Backend: Node.js (Express/Nest)
  • Frontend: React
  • AI support: prompt engineering, RAG, escalation rules, empathetic tone
  • Detail-oriented, clear written English
  • Peptides experience a plus


Salary

3k USD/month

title: AI Performance Creative Designer (Streetwear/Exotic Cars)
description:
So… what the hell is Ark Exotic?

Ark Exotic is where founders and creatives who've already made it come to gather and access our fleet.


Our members have driven everything. The novelty is gone. What they're chasing now is the social moments that they can't find anywhere else. We want to build a world of underground luxury that feel like scenes from a film.


Now we're building a creative team to match and we need an AI-native performance designer who can sell the feeling of being inside Ark.


What You'll Do

  • Design performance creatives that feel like film stills, not ads
  • Generate scroll-stopping visuals that pull our target deeper into the world (and the funnel)
  • Build on-image copy that speaks to a young successful founders
  • Maintain a visual language across motorsport, lifestyle, clothing, and brand storytelling pillars
  • Move fast — produce cinematic visuals at the volume performance marketing demands


Who You Are

  • We don't care about your years of experience. We care about your eye and what you've built.
  • You've built performance ads for premium DTC, lifestyle, or fashion brands before
  • You've mastered Freepik Spaces, Higgsfield, Runway, Midjourney, and OpenAI's Image 2
  • You understand the difference between \"looks expensive\" and \"feels exclusive\"
  • Your portfolio looks like an A24 mood board, not a Canva carousel
  • You've created something of your own — a brand, a zine, a film, a photo series, a fit page that proves you don't need a brief to build a world
  • You follow filmmakers, fashion houses, and underground car culture in equal measure
  • Streetwear, automotive, fashion, or film background? You're already shortlisted.
  • You can tell me without thinking why the Gentle Monster \"Hunt\" campaign works, or why a single shot of a wet parking lot at night can carry an entire brand


What We're Building

  • The most-watched private world in luxury automotive. Members don't join for the cars. They join for the access, the people, and the feeling of being on the inside of something most people will never see.
  • This role defines what that world looks like to anyone discovering us for the first time. Your work will be the first impression for people who've never been impressed.


What We're Offering

  • Competitive salary based on your portfolio
  • 10 days PTO per year
  • Path to grow into creative lead / brand director as we scale
  • Fully remote


How to Apply

  • A portfolio showing off your streetwear / midnight club design language
  • A short paragraph on how you'd approach the visual feel of an Ark Exotic ad campaign


If the interview goes well, we hire on the call. Welcome to Ark.

title: Analista de IA Sênior
description:
A Atos é uma empresa líder mundial em transformação digital, oferecendo serviços de transação de alta tecnologia, consultoria, integração de sistemas, cloud e serviços gerenciados. Além disso, anunciada como parceira mundial de TI nos Jogos Olímpicos e Paraolímpicos!


Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.


Estamos buscando um Analista de IA Sênior para se juntar ao nosso time no desenvolvimento de soluções de IA. Aqui não tem monotonia. Somos um time de solucionadores de desafios de clientes de grande porte nos mais diversos mercados.

Com desafios tão diversos, precisamos de pessoas que tenham uma boa base teórica de IA, experiência diversificada em projetos reais e a habilidade de resolver problemas novos com autonomia.



Requisitos:

  • Experiência na área de IA OU na área de desenvolvimento de software com com vivência na área de IA;
  • Experiência em conduzir projetos junto ao cliente, desde o levantamento de requisitos até as decisões técnicas;
  • Habilidades de comunicação e liderança para apoiar o crescimento de profissionais com menos experiência do time;
  • Graduação em cursos da área de computação OU Pós-graduação na área de IA e experiência prévia como analista de sistemas;
  • Ter desenvolvido ao menos um projeto real com IA Generativa (não vale só prompt engineering, ok?);
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de soluções em ambiente de cloud, preferencialmente GCP ou Azure;
  • Python fluente;
  • Inglês avançado (ao menos para leitura e compreensão oral).



Desejável:

  • Experiência previa como analista de sistemas;
  • Experiência em projetos de visão computacional;
  • Certificações Cloud.

Plano de saúde

Plano odontológico

Wellhub (Gympass)

title: Senior Compliance Manager
description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE

The Senior Compliance Manager will join the global legal and compliance team, with a primary focus on Brazil and the broader Latin American regulatory landscape. This role requires a proactive self-starter with a strong interest in financial innovation and digital assets, who thrives in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will lead regulatory and licensing efforts related to crypto operations in Brazil while supporting regional expansion initiatives.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead regulatory compliance strategy and licensing/registration efforts for crypto-related activities in Brazil, including engagement with the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (CVM), and other relevant authorities
  • Monitor and interpret developments in Brazil’s crypto regulatory framework (e.g., Law No. 14,478/2022 and related regulations), and assess their impact on business operations
  • Act as the primary project manager for licensing and regulatory initiatives, coordinating with external counsel, consultants, and internal stakeholders
  • Provide clear, practical, and solution-oriented compliance guidance to product, operations, and business teams to enable compliant product launches and expansion
  • Deliver internal training programs and update training materials to reflect regulatory changes and best practices
  • Represent the company in interactions with regulators, financial institutions, partners, and industry groups in Brazil


Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s crypto and financial regulatory environment, including digital asset frameworks and payment systems (e.g., PIX)
  • Familiarity with AML/CFT regulations, data protection (LGPD), and financial consumer protection laws in Brazil
  • Experience in the crypto, fintech, or payments industry is highly preferred
  • Understanding of global regulatory trends in digital assets is a plus


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field
  • 7 to 9 years of regulatory compliance experience, with at least 3 years focused on crypto, fintech, payments, or financial services in Brazil
  • Proven experience handling regulatory licensing, compliance frameworks, and regulator engagement in Brazil
  • Ability to advise on regulatory implications for product design, modification, and market expansion
  • Strong ability to navigate a dynamic and evolving regulatory landscape with ambiguity
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and ability to work cross-functionally with senior management
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain composed under pressure
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Portuguese (Mandarin is a plus but not required)
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively and deliver practical, scalable compliance solutions
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefit

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Sênior
description:
Se você busca novos desafios e deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e inovador, essa oportunidade é para você! Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Salesforce apaixonado por tecnologia e soluções de CRM, que queira contribuir com seu conhecimento e crescer junto com a nossa equipe.


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver e apoiar atividades de modelagem de dados no ambiente Salesforce, incluindo criação de objetos, campos e processos automatizados (flows, workflows, validation rules, process builders);

  • Participar do processo de code review, garantindo qualidade e consistência do código;
  • Atuar com conhecimentos específicos da plataforma Salesforce, alinhado aos princípios de qualidade do CoE (Centro Operacional de Excelência em Salesforce) e políticas de governança;

O que esperamos de você?

  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com desenvolvimento end-to-end, incluindo levantamento de necessidades, implantação, implementação, testes e homologação.
  • Requerida experiência de 2 anos com Sales Cloud ou Service Cloud.
  • Requerida experiência com data modeling e data management no ambiente Salesforce.

  • Requerida experiência com Apex Testing.

  • Requerida experiência com Platform Development basics.
  • Requerida experiência com Lightning Experience Development.
  • Requerida experiência com alguma ferramenta de CI/CD (ex.: Flosum, Git).


Diferenciais que podem te destacar:

  • Ensino superior em Administração, Engenharia de sistemas ou Tecnologia da Informação;

  • Experiência com Salesforce e Salesforce Marketing Cloud;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Lean, Kanban, SAFe etc.);
  • Experiência com indicadores de CRM;
  • Experiência com modelo arquitetural REST/SOAP;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Experiência com o mercado Segurador, Previdenciário e/ou Financeiro.


Habilidades comportamentais que valorizamos:

title: AI Agent Development & Delivery Manager-Brazil
description:
AI Agent Builder Job Core Responsibilities

  • Agent Construction & Workflow Setup: Use low-code platforms (e.g., Coze, n8n, Dify) to build and debug Chatflows. You will be responsible for setting up the logic branches, slot filling, and task-oriented closed loops.
  • Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Write and refine high-quality System Prompts to control AI behavior, persona, and task accuracy. Continuously optimize prompts based on real-world interaction data.
  • System Integration & Debugging: Support the integration of AI Agents with client systems (CRM, Helpdesk, etc.) via APIs and Webhooks. Use basic coding (Python/JS) to handle data parsing and custom logic nodes.

AI Agent Builder Core Qualifications

  • Language: Fluent in English (Spoken & Written). You can confidently lead technical meetings and write high-quality, professional prompts/documentation.
  • Logical Thinking: Strong ability to deconstruct complex business needs into clear, step-by-step logic flows.
  • Technical Foundation:
  • Basic Python/JS skills (must know how to parse JSON and handle API/Webhook data).
  • Conceptual understanding of LLMs and a strong intuition for Prompt Engineering .
  • Fast Learner: Ability to quickly master new Agent Builder/Workflow tools (e.g., Coze, n8n) and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: Especialista Banco de Dados Oracle/AWS - 132298
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional Especialista DBA Oracle com experiência em Cloud AWS e vivência no setor bancário para atuação remota.

Responsabilidades:

  • Realização de comprovações (POCs) para migração de workloads PIX do mainframe para AWS.
  • Validar o DynamoDB AWS como mecanismo de persistência para cargas críticas, avaliando aderência a requisitos funcionais e não funcionais.
  • Desenhar e validar o sincronismo entre DynamoDB e Oracle (near-real-time), garantindo: Linha contábil;
  • Reconciliação Geração de extratos;
  • Definir e aplicar modelagem de dados e padrões de uso para NoSQL e relacional.
  • Projetar e acompanhar pipelines de eventos para integração entre sistemas.
  • Executar e analisar testes de performance, concorrência e volume.
  • Executar e analisar testes de consistência de dados entre DynamoDB e Oracle.
  • Monitorar ambientes, identificar gargalos e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Atuar em incidentes críticos, com análise de causa raiz.
  • Garantir segurança, controle de acesso e rastreabilidade dos dados.
  • Documentar arquiteturas, decisões técnicas e boas práticas.
  • Modelagem e padrões
  • Definir padrões de modelagem para DynamoDB (partitions, índices, acesso).
  • Alinhar modelagem Oracle × DynamoDB considerando consistência e performance.
  • Definir padrões de versionamento e rastreabilidade de dados.
  • Pipeline de eventos
  • Apoiar o desenho de pipelines baseados em eventos para sincronismo de dados.
  • Garantir confiabilidade, ordenação (quando necessário) e tratamento de falhas.
  • Validar estratégias de reprocessamento e compensação.
  • Testes de performance
  • Planejar e executar testes de carga, estresse e concorrência.
  • Avaliar escalabilidade do DynamoDB frente a picos de acesso.
  • Comparar resultados com requisitos de negócio e SLAs.
  • Testes de consistência
  • Garantir consistência dos dados entre Oracle e DynamoDB.
  • Apoiar processos de reconciliação e auditoria.
  • Validar comportamento em cenários de falha e recuperação.

Requisitos :


  • Experiência com Oracle: Administração de ambientes críticos Performance e tuning Backup, restore e alta disponibilidade;
  • Experiência prática com AWS DynamoDB: Modelagem NoSQL orientada a acesso Índices globais e locais;
  • Monitoramento e análise de custo/performance;
  • Vivência com sistemas de alta concorrência e grande volume;
  • Conhecimentos em Linux;
  • Capacidade de análise e troubleshooting avançado.


Desejável:


  • Certificação AWS e/ou Oracle;
  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos;
  • Vivência em ambientes financeiros, contábeis ou regulados;
  • Conhecimento de automação e scripts;
  • Experiência com práticas de resiliência e tolerância a falhas.

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;

title: Arquiteto de Soluções Sênior (SAP + Salesforce)
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Soluções Sênior com forte experiência em ecossistemas SAP e Salesforce , responsável por desenhar, evoluir e governar arquiteturas de integração complexas, garantindo alta performance, segurança e escalabilidade das soluções.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de integrações entre SAP , SuccessFactors (SF) , Salesforce , Middleware e OTM (Oracle Transportation Management)
  • Garantir padrões técnicos, boas práticas de desenvolvimento, segurança, performance e escalabilidade
  • Apoiar decisões técnicas críticas envolvendo EDI, Pricing, Mobile e integrações logísticas (OTM)
  • Atuar na governança técnica dos projetos, assegurando consistência entre as soluções implementadas
  • Acompanhar dependências técnicas e integrações entre squads ao longo das Sprints
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times funcionais, técnicos e stakeholders de negócio
  • Definir e manter diretrizes de arquitetura para integrações entre SF, SAP e Middleware/OTM
  • Garantir alinhamento técnico entre diferentes frentes e projetos simultâneos


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Arquiteto(a) de Soluções em ambientes complexos
  • Vivência comprovada com integrações entre SAP e Salesforce
  • Conhecimento em SuccessFactors (SF) e integrações com SAP
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Middleware (ex: PI/PO, CPI, MuleSoft ou similares)
  • Forte conhecimento em arquitetura de integração (APIs, mensageria, EDI, etc.)
  • Experiência com integrações logísticas e/ou OTM
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança, performance e escalabilidade de sistemas
  • Experiência atuando em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com projetos globais ou ambientes multi-país
  • Certificações em SAP , Salesforce ou arquitetura (TOGAF, etc.)
  • Vivência com soluções de Pricing e Mobile
  • Experiência com governança técnica em ambientes com múltiplos squads
