title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados (DBA)
description:
O objetivo desta função é fornecer know-how técnico para as nossas soluções de marketing de banco de dados. A função exige profundo conhecimento de conceitos de banco de dados relacionais e proficiência em SQL. A função será responsável por criar e modificar o código de banco de dados, bem como ajudar com os aspectos operacionais do banco de dados.


PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES


  • Tem experiência com a aplicação prática de conceitos relacionais de banco de dados, armazenamento de dados e gerenciamento de arquivos.
  • Tem uma compreensão sólida de SQL e da linguagem de programação de base de dados.
  • Tem uma compreensão sólida das ferramentas e dos conceitos de ETL.
  • Tem experiência com a aplicação prática de ferramentas de programação de trabalho.
  • Tem conhecimento de metodologias e ferramentas de desenvolvimento.
  • Tem uma compreensão sólida das ofertas comuns de TI, ou seja, armazenamento, backups e sistemas operacionais.
  • Participa e contribui com revisões de projeto e código.
  • Desenvolve código para atender às especificações de projeto e realiza testes de unidade precisos no código desenvolvido.


Requisitos e Qualificações


  • Experiência com a aplicação prática de conceitos relacionais de banco de dados, armazenamento de dados e gerenciamento de arquivos.
  • Compreensão sólida de SQL e da linguagem de programação de base de dados.
  • Domínio das ferramentas e dos conceitos de ETL.
  • Experiência com a aplicação prática de ferramentas de programação de trabalho.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias e ferramentas de desenvolvimento.
  • Entendimento sólido de ofertas comuns de TI, como armazenamento, backups e sistemas operacionais.


O que você vai encontrar por aqui:

  • Plano de saúde e Odontológico Sulamérica extensivo a dependentes
  • Seguro de vida
  • VR ou VA
  • Auxílio home office
  • Auxílio Creche (para filhos até 5 anos e 11 meses);
  • Plataforma de Aprendizagem eLearning (Dentsu university)
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento de Carreira
  • Parceria para desenvolvimento de idiomas, especialização, pós-graduação e MBA
  • Programas de desenvolvimento local e Global
  • Day Off de Aniversário;


Sobre a dentsu internacional

Parte da dentsu, dentsu internacional com sede em Londres, opera em mais de 145 mercados no mundo inteiro com mais de 48.000 colaboradores. Ajudamos nossos clientes a conquistar, manter e fazer crescer seus consumidores e alcançar um progresso significativo para os seus negócios. Com os melhores serviços e soluções em mídia, CXM, e criatividade.


Trabalhando conosco

Juntando-se à dentsu international, você se juntará a um grupo de 48.000 pessoas. Será uma oportunidade de produzir trabalho orientado para a construção da sua carreira. Ao longo do caminho, você se unirá a colegas inspiradores e encontrará uma riqueza de clientes, culturas e experiências. Oferecemos desafios motivadores, experiências memoráveis e oportunidades para moldar seu futuro.

Inclusão e Diversidade

Estamos orgulhosos de ser diferente e isso começa com nossa gente. title: Consultor SAP BTP
description:
A Softtek está em busca de um(a) Consultor ABAP - BTP para fazer parte do nosso time e atuar em projetos desafiadores e de grande relevância!


Responsabilidades:

  • Avaliar o uso atual da SAP BTP no landscape e identificar impactos do upgrade do S/4HANA 2025 sobre integrações e extensões existentes.
  • Apoiar a definição e implementação de estratégias de extensibilidade sidebyside, alinhadas ao conceito de Clean Core SAP.
  • Atuar na revisão, adaptação ou criação de integrações utilizando SAP Integration Suite (ex.: CPI).
  • Garantir compatibilidade entre o S/4HANA upgrade e aplicações desenvolvidas em CAP, Fiori, APIs, eventos e serviços BTP.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times SAP (funcional, ABAP, Basis) e com o gerente de projeto para gerenciar dependências técnicas.
  • Apoiar a governança técnica das soluções BTP em um cenário com múltiplos projetos simultâneos.
  • Orientar decisões arquiteturais para reduzir customizações no core e viabilizar futuras evoluções do ERP.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada como Consultor SAP BTP, atuando com S/4HANA.
  • Vivência em projetos de upgrade SAP, preferencialmente com impactos em integrações ou extensibilidade.
  • Conhecimento das boas práticas SAP para Clean Core e extensibility strategy.
  • Experiência com pelo menos um dos componentes da BTP:
  • SAP Integration Suite (CPI)
  • SAP Extension Suite
  • SAP Event Mesh / APIs
  • Capacidade de atuação partime, com boa organização e foco em entregas.

description:

Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Senior Cloud Engineer with experience in two or more cloud technologies (AWS or Azure) to join our growing team in a support, engineering, and consulting role. In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in cloud architecture, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the success of our clients.


What You'll Do:


  • Manage and respond to customer-facing support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with senior architects and consultants to understand client requirements and develop and support scalable cloud-based solutions.
  • Apply best practice framework principles to evaluate and improve client architecture.
  • Apply FinOps best practices to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud costs, including cost allocation, budget tracking, and implementing cost-saving strategies.
  • Support and assist clients with AI/ML workloads and implementations using cloud provider services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and other AI tools.
  • Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure components such as virtual compute instances (VMs & containers), storage services, databases, and virtual networks (VNet & VPC).
  • Provide technical support to clients, including troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring security best practices.
  • Configure and manage cloud resources, including virtual compute instances, storage services, databases, virtual networks, and more.
  • Develop and document infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Amazon CloudFormation & CDK, Azure ARM, Azure Bicap, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, or Terraform.
  • Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline.
  • Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients.
  • Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use.
  • Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.


What We're Looking For:


  • Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment.
  • At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security.
  • Understanding of AWS, and Azure framework principles and practices.
  • Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices.
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows.
  • Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.


Bonus Points For:


  • Certifications in more than one cloud provider
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools.
  • Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services.
  • Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews.
  • Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices.
  • Experience in a technology consulting environment.
  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms.


What We Offer:


  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs.


Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. Apply now to become part of our innovative and dynamic team!

title: Analista de Controladoria Sênior
description:
Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de lentes oftálmicas, armações e óculos de sol. A empresa reúne a expertise complementar de dois pioneiros da indústria, um em tecnologias avançadas de lentes e outro na arte da fabricação de óculos icônicos, criando um negócio verticalmente integrado, única e exclusivamente posicionado para atender às necessidades de visão em constante evolução do mundo e à demanda global de uma indústria de óculos em crescimento. Com mais de 180.000 colaboradores em 150 países impulsionando nossas marcas icônicas, nossas pessoas são criativas, empreendedoras e reconhecidas por suas perspectivas e individualidades únicas. Comprometidos com a visão, nós capacitamos as pessoas a \"verem mais e serem mais\" graças aos nossos designs inovadores e tecnologias de lentes, qualidade excepcional e métodos de processamento de ponta. Todos os dias impactamos a vida de milhões de pessoas ao mudar a maneira como elas veem o mundo.


O analista irá realizar análises financeiras e de custos complexas, garantindo a acuracidade dos fechamentos mensais, projeções e indicadores. Atua como referência técnica para o time, suportando decisões estratégicas da fábrica e contribuindo para projetos de melhoria contínua, assegurando conformidade com políticas corporativas e normas contábeis.



  • Garantir a execução e qualidade do fechamento mensal de custos, realizando análises detalhadas de variações e tendências.


  • Elaborar e validar projeções (forecast) e suportar o processo de Budget anual, assegurando consistência e alinhamento estratégico.


  • Realizar análises avançadas de custos industriais, incluindo cálculo de novos produtos, business case industrial


  • Desenvolver relatórios gerenciais e dashboards com insights para tomada de decisão.


  • Participar de projetos de melhoria contínua e iniciativas de eficiência financeira.


  • Atuar como referência técnica para analistas plenos e juniores, apoiando na resolução de problemas complexos.





REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS

Formação: Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, engenharia ou áreas correlatas

Experiência em Controladoria de Custos




Conhecimentos Específicos / Habilidades

Excel avançado

SAP e Oracle (desejável)

Análise de custos e orçamentos

Inglês avançado (leitura e escrita; conversação intermediária)

Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (desejável)

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
Cientista de Dados


Sobre a Arvo

Temos o propósito de tornar a saúde no Brasil mais acessível para todos. Nossa jornada começa com o uso de dados e inteligência artificial para reduzir fraudes, abusos e desperdícios em pagamentos de saúde. Acreditamos que a única maneira de alcançar isso é através de um time incrível, com pessoas apaixonadas por saúde e compradas na nossa missão de transformar o setor.


Perfil desejado

Buscamos uma pessoa cientista de dados com forte capacidade analítica, curiosidade e autonomia para explorar novos problemas e domínios. Alguém com perfil crítico e generalista, que se motive mais por entender e resolver problemas complexos com dados do que apenas por desenvolver modelos ou escrever código.

Procuramos alguém que combine rigor técnico e pensamento científico, com uma barra de qualidade alta. Que seja capaz de propor hipóteses, testar soluções de forma estruturada e entregar resultados robustos, bem validados e sustentáveis.


Responsabilidades

  • Analisar dados complexos e extrair insights que gerem valor para o negócio e para os clientes
  • Desenvolver relatórios, dashboards e visualizações de dados para comunicação de resultados
  • Identificar tendências, padrões e anomalias nos dados para apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de engenharia de dados para garantir qualidade, integridade e acessibilidade dos dados
  • Criar e documentar métricas de desempenho e indicadores-chave para monitoramento dos processos
  • Apoiar na definição de requisitos e especificação de soluções baseadas em dados
  • Realizar estudos de viabilidade e análise de impacto de soluções propostas
  • Comunicar de forma clara e objetiva os achados analíticos para diferentes stakeholders


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Formação em Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou área correlata
  • Conhecimento em Python
  • Experiência com análise de dados e geração de insights acionáveis
  • Experiência em manipulação e consulta de bancos de dados SQL e não relacionais
  • Boa comunicação para interagir com diferentes stakeholders e traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções analíticas
  • Experiência com modelagem estatística ou machine learning.


Qualificações Desejadas

  • Experiência na área de healthtech
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de ETL
  • Familiaridade com Google Cloud (GCP) e BigQuery


Descrição da vaga

Essa pessoa será responsável por analisar dados complexos da carteira de clientes, identificar padrões e oportunidades e traduzir insights em recomendações estratégicas. Trabalhará em parceria com os times de Business e Health, desenvolvendo relatórios e dashboards que apoiem a tomada de decisão. Também atuará junto à engenharia de dados para garantir a qualidade e acessibilidade das informações, além de definir métricas e indicadores para monitorar o desempenho das iniciativas.


Benefícios

Plano de Saúde Bradesco Saúde Nacional II (TNMI)

VA/VR: R$1.080 no Flash

Acesso ao wellhub (gympass)

Vaga remota

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (Frontend Focus)


About the Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack developer with a strong frontend orientation who is passionate about building modern, polished user interfaces — and who actively leverages generative AI tools to do so faster and better. You'll own the frontend experience end-to-end while contributing meaningfully to backend systems built in Python.


What We're Looking For:

Hands-on experience with React and are comfortable working across the modern frontend ecosystem (Vue, Svelte, Angular, or similar). You understand the fundamentals — HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive design, accessibility — and use frameworks as tools rather than crutches. You are fluent in AI-assisted development. You use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI coding platforms as a core part of your workflow — not as a novelty, but as a productivity multiplier. You can articulate how AI changes the way you architect, prototype, and ship frontend code. Ideally, you're genuinely excited about AI and follow the space closely.

On the backend, you bring strong Python skills. You've built APIs, worked with frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask, and are comfortable with databases, authentication, and deployment. You don't just \"know some Python\" — you can design and build backend services confidently.


Key Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in React; working knowledge of at least one other modern frontend framework Strong command of TypeScript, modern CSS, and responsive/accessible design
  • Demonstrated active use of generative AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)
  • Strong Python backend skills — experience building APIs, working with databases, and deploying services
  • Comfort with the full stack: you can go from a Figma mockup to a deployed feature independently


Nice to Have Experience

  • Building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs into products
  • Familiarity with modern deployment and DevOps practices (Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms)

title: Freelancer | AEM Content Author (Adobe Experience Manager)
description:
Buscamos um(a) AEM Content Author responsável pela publicação de conteúdos digitais no Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), garantindo consistência, qualidade e alinhamento com as diretrizes de marca e estratégia digital da empresa.

Esse profissional atuará em conjunto com times de marketing, UX/UI e tecnologia, sendo responsável por assegurar que os conteúdos sejam entregues com excelência, seguindo boas práticas de usabilidade, SEO e governança, além de contribuir para a evolução contínua da operação digital.


PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Criar, editar e publicar páginas, componentes e conteúdos no Adobe Experience Manager (AEM);
  • Gerenciar a estrutura de navegação, organização de páginas, taxonomia e metadados;
  • Garantir a correta aplicação de SEO on-page, acessibilidade e boas práticas de conteúdo;
  • Revisar conteúdos assegurando consistência visual, textual e aderência às diretrizes de marca;
  • Validar o comportamento das páginas em diferentes dispositivos (desktop, tablet e mobile);
  • Apoiar campanhas digitais, lançamentos de produtos e atualizações de conteúdo recorrentes;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de marketing, design, produto e tecnologia;
  • Realizar testes básicos antes da publicação (links, imagens, componentes, navegação);
  • Identificar e reportar inconsistências ou bugs, colaborando com times técnicos na resolução;
  • Apoiar a validação de novos componentes e funcionalidades dentro do AEM;
  • Contribuir para a organização e melhoria contínua dos processos de publicação e governança de conteúdo.

REQUISITOS

  • Experiência comprovada com Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) como Content Author;
  • Conhecimento em estrutura de páginas, templates e componentes no AEM;
  • Noções de HTML e CSS para entendimento de estrutura e ajustes básicos;
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de SEO e acessibilidade;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de design como Figma e Adobe Photoshop;
  • Perfil organizado, com atenção a detalhes e foco em qualidade;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar com times multidisciplinares.


DESEJÁVEL

  • Experiência com ferramentas do ecossistema Adobe, como Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Adobe Launch, Adobe Assets;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise como Google Analytics 4 (GA4) e Google Tag Manager (GTM);
  • Conhecimento em personalização de conteúdo e segmentação de audiência;
  • Experiência com CMS headless ou arquiteturas híbridas;
  • Experiência com CMS Wordpress, Drupal, Joomla ou similares;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de apoio à criação de conteúdo baseadas em AI, como ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly ou assistentes de escrita e otimização de conteúdo;
  • Noções de uso de AI para geração, revisão e otimização de conteúdo (SEO, copy, variações);
  • Experiência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

title: Regional Manager of Analytical Services
description:
BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.

To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!

British American Tobacco Brazil has an exciting opportunity for a Regional Manager of Analytical Services in Cachoerinha

The role is responsible for leading and optimizing analytical laboratory operations, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and innovation while fostering a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement. This role bridges science, business, and compliance to support the company’s strategic objectives.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Responsible for three tobacco analysis laboratories.
  • Ensure compliance with government regulatory requirements.
  • Guarantee that all laboratory operations follow government mandated standards.
  • Lead laboratory operations, focusing on operational excellence and process optimization.
  • Oversee science, business, and compliance aspects, fostering a strong safety culture, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Chemistry, Engineering or related field.
  • Professional council registration: CRQ or CREA.
  • Strong understanding of laboratory operations.
  • Familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements in laboratory or FMCG/regulated industries.
  • Familiarity of Lean Manufacturing / IWS principles and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Strong knowledge in Science and Quality.
  • Familiarity with Regulatory standards (ANVISA, ISO 17025), quality systems, and compliance frameworks.
  • Strong leadership, strategic thinking and people management, with ability to coach, engage, and develop teams.
  • Excellent organisational and coordination skills to manage multiple workflows effectively.
  • Analytical and problem-solving mindset, with focus on optimizing costs, resources, and timelines.
  • Clear and effective communication, capable of influencing and aligning internal stakeholders.
  • Scientific, efficiency and customer-centric approaches, ensuring responsiveness and service excellence.

What we offer you?


  • We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)
  • Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives
  • Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter starts here.
  • You'll have access to online learning platforms and personalized growth programs to nurture your leadership skills
  • We prioritize continuous improvement within a transformative environment, preparing for ongoing changes


WHY JOIN BAT?


We’re one of the few companies named as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute – certified in offering excellent employee conditions.


Collaboration, inclusion and partnership underpin everything we do here at BAT. We are looking forward to enabling every individual to thrive, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, skills, experience, education, socio-economic and professional background, veteran status, perspectives and thinking styles. We know that embracing talent from all backgrounds is what makes us stronger and best prepared to meet our business goals.


We see the career breaks as opportunities not obstacles. Through The Global Returners program, we support professionals looking to restart their careers after an extended absence from the workforce (e.g. time out caring for family, parental leave, national service, sabbatical and/or starting an own venture).


Come bring your difference and see what is possible for you at BAT. Learn more about our culture and our award winning employee experience here.


If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best during the recruitment process, you are encouraged to notify us. We are fully committed to support you by making appropriate arrangements for you to demonstrate your full potential.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: SAP SD
description:
We are looking for an experienced SAP SD Functional Consultant to support the Brazil Tax Reform Program , ensuring full readiness and adaptation of Order-to‑Cash processes to the new tax structure (IVA Dual / CBS). This role requires strong functional expertise, deep knowledge of Brazilian localization, and hands‑on experience with tax‑related SAP projects.

Key Requirements

  • Advanced English (mandatory).
  • Experience in SAP SD / Order‑to‑Cash.
  • Strong hands‑on expertise in Brazilian localization , including:
  • NFe
  • CFOP
  • Tax conditions
  • Pricing determination
  • Proven experience with Brazil Tax Reform readiness , including mapping new tax scenarios and adapting SD billing flows.
  • Knowledge of integration points with FI/MM related to tax calculation.
  • Previous participation in SAP upgrade, rollout, or legal change projects .

Responsibilities

  • Analyze existing SD processes and determine required adjustments related to the Tax Reform.
  • Redesign pricing schemas, tax condition records, fiscal flows, and billing structures (IVA Dual / CBS).
  • Prepare functional specifications and collaborate closely with technical (ABAP) teams.
  • Lead integration testing, regression testing, and UAT cycles.
  • Support Cutover , Go‑Live , and Hypercare phases.
  • Produce functional documentation and deliver training to business users.
  • Work collaboratively with cross‑functional teams (tax, finance, logistics).

title: Cloudbees DevOps Engineer
description:
Cloudbees DevOps Engineer – Help Shape the Future of Continuous Delivery at a Global Financial Technology Leader!


Join a mission-critical engineering organisation at the heart of one of the world’s most influential financial messaging and payments platforms. Become part of a global DevOps Engineering Services team enabling modern software delivery, automation, and orchestration across a highly complex, secure, and fast-moving technology landscape. Supporting internal engineering teams across the enterprise, you’ll contribute to a mature and rapidly expanding initiative driving CI/CD/RO adoption - powering over 100+ applications and accelerating delivery excellence for teams primarily across the United States.


This is your opportunity to work inside a global organisation transforming the way software is built, released, and operated - while collaborating with senior engineers and DevOps experts across continents.


Your Role as a Cloudbees DevOps Engineer

As a DevOps Engineer within the DevOps Engineering Services team, you’ll help deliver internal tooling, automation, and release orchestration capabilities that empower hundreds of developers and application teams.

Working in a transversal function, you’ll support the rollout and optimisation of CloudBees Release Orchestration (RO) and CI/CD best practices, ensuring smooth adoption and consistent execution across the organisation. You'll contribute to a mature programme governed by senior engineers, with clear guidance, structured delivery, and high-impact outcomes across enterprise DevOps environments.


What You’ll Do

  • Support adoption of CI/CD and RO tooling across internal DevOps teams
  • Work closely with Senior Engineers to execute release orchestration onboarding tasks
  • Assist in scaling the enterprise adoption of CloudBees RO, Jenkins, CloudBees CI/CD
  • Enable best practices for Git workflows, artefact management (Nexus), and code quality (SonarQube)
  • Support SAST/DAST integration within secure delivery pipelines
  • Provide technical support to internal teams as they adopt enterprise DevOps tooling
  • Contribute to IaC and automation efforts using Python and Ansible Automation Platform
  • Support containerisation initiatives using Docker and OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Collaborate in an Agile, DevSecOps-driven environment to standardise delivery processes
  • Ensure accurate documentation, repeatable execution, and alignment to engineering guidelines


What You Bring

  • 4+ years of DevOps engineering experience
  • Hands-on expertise with CI/CD tooling, ideally CloudBees.
  • Hands on experience with Jenkins, Git, Nexus, SonarQube
  • Experience with SAST/DAST tools
  • Practical development experience in Java/Maven or C++
  • Exposure to infrastructure automation using Python and Ansible
  • Knowledge of containerisation: Docker, OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of Agile and DevSecOps principles
  • Excellent English communication skills (client teams are primarily US-based)
  • Ability to follow established engineering patterns and execute with precision

Why Join the Remobi Community

  • 100% remote B2B/freelance contracts
  • Access to a global network of top-tier engineering opportunities
  • Curated content, role alerts, and a supportive contractor community


Apply today: If you're ready to elevate software delivery excellence at scale and support a global CDRO transformation initiative - we want to hear from you!

description:
Estamos em busca de professoras de inglês para atuação em parceria com o Inglês Empoderado, escola de ensino online focada em conversação para alunos adultos.


A atuação será realizada como prestadora de serviços (modelo PJ) , com foco na condução de aulas ao vivo e acompanhamento do desenvolvimento das alunas.


Formato de Atuação:

• Prestação de serviços educacionais (modelo PJ)

• Aulas 100% online (Google Meet)

• Atuação com alunos adultos (níveis iniciante ao intermediário)

• Utilização de material de apoio disponibilizado pela escola

• Remuneração por hora/aula


Modelo de Parceria:

A atuação não configura vínculo empregatício, sendo realizada de forma autônoma , com liberdade de organização da agenda. Trata-se de prestação de serviços sem exclusividade , podendo a profissional atuar com outras instituições.


Buscamos parceiras que:

• Tenham experiência com aulas online

• Conduzam aulas com foco em conversação

• Tenham boa comunicação e didática com adultos

• Sejam organizadas e comprometidas com a experiência da aluna

• Tenham familiaridade com ferramentas digitais (Google Meet, Docs, etc.)

title: Software Engineer
description:
Intelligence Architect | Brazil

Conquer AI is hiring an Intelligence Architect to help us design and deliver real-world AI systems for enterprise clients in Brazil.


This is not a research-only role, and it is not a strategy-only role.

We are looking for a strong software engineer who can work directly with clients, run technical discovery, shape use cases, and then build the solution from POC through MVP and Phase 1 delivery.


Think forward deployed engineer. A hands-on builder who can sit with business stakeholders, understand how work actually happens, and turn that into practical AI systems.


What we’re looking for

  • Strong software engineering background
  • Experience with RAG, LLMs, machine learning, and AI application development
  • Strong hands-on skills in Python and Node.js
  • Ability to design, build, and deploy production-ready systems
  • Confident working directly with clients and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Able to move from problem definition to technical architecture to delivery
  • Strong communication, ownership, and execution skills


What you’ll do

  • Work closely with clients to uncover high-value AI opportunities
  • Lead discovery sessions and translate business problems into technical solutions
  • Build POCs, MVPs, and early production systems
  • Design workflows that combine retrieval, reasoning, automation, and human-in-the-loop review
  • Operate as a trusted technical lead across both client-facing and delivery work
  • Help ensure what gets built is usable, scalable, and grounded in real workflows


This role is a fit for you if

  • You are a builder first
  • You can speak to executives, operators, and engineers without losing the thread
  • You enjoy solving messy workflow problems with elegant technical systems
  • You want to work on high-impact AI delivery, not internal experiments

We’d love to hear from engineers who want to build serious AI systems in the real world.

title: Operations Director
description:
Kinetic Homes - Operations Director


Introduction:

Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.


This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.


Compensation:

  • $40,000-90,000 USD per year.


Duties & Responsibilities:


Permitting

  • Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.
  • Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.
  • Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.
  • Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.
  • Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.
  • Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.
  • Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.
  • Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.


Development Support

  • Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.
  • File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.


Procurement

  • Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.
  • Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.
  • Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.


Transaction Support

  • Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.
  • Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.
  • Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.


Qualifications:

  • University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment
  • Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.
  • Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.
  • Possess strong verbal and written English skills.
  • Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.
  • Willing to work in high-pressure environment.
  • Willing to be responsive and communicative.
  • Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9AM to 5PM EST.
  • The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.
  • Good attitude necessary.

title: Branding and Design Manager
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re looking for a creative Branding Manager with strong graphic design skills to help us define, refine, and execute our brand identity. This is a project-based role, ideal for someone who can balance creative strategy with hands-on design execution.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Develop or refine our visual brand identity (logos, color palettes, typography, imagery, etc.)
  • Collaborate with the team to translate brand strategy into visuals that resonate with our audience
  • Create brand guidelines to ensure consistent use across all platforms and materials
  • Design marketing assets such as social media graphics, presentations, brochures, and digital/print collateral
  • Ensure all designs align with brand messaging, tone, and positioning
  • Provide direction or templates that can be reused by the team after project completion


Who We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in branding and graphic design (portfolio required)
  • Strong proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, or Canva
  • Understanding of brand strategy, positioning, and storytelling
  • Experience creating brand identities for startups or growing companies (nice to have!)
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (only if role transitions to full-time)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages (only if role transitions to full-time)
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace


Project Details:

  • Type: Project-based (with potential for future project-based, part-time, or full-time role)
  • Compensation: Competitive, based on experience and project scope
  • Duration: To be discussed based on project requirements

description:

title: IT Site Support Manager
description:
Overview

The IT Site Support Manager is responsible for leading and developing the IT Site Support Team, delivering a high-quality end-user experience, and ensuring the effective application of ITIL best practices. This role plays a critical part in standardizing IT support operations, optimizing costs, and ensuring compliance with corporate IT and security standards.

The manager will collaborate closely with global IT teams, vendors, and business stakeholders, supporting enterprise initiatives and ensuring consistent, efficient, and secure IT support services across the site.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance Management

  • Lead, coach, and manage the IT Site Support team to ensure individual and team performance expectations are consistently met.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and support skills development and career growth.
  • Ensure adequate staffing, workload distribution, and coverage to meet business needs.

End-User Experience & Service Delivery

  • Drive continuous improvement of the end-user IT support experience.
  • Measure service satisfaction levels, analyze feedback, and implement improvement actions.
  • Manage and uphold the incident troubleshooting and escalation process to ensure timely and effective resolution.

ITIL, Process & Operational Excellence

  • Apply ITIL best practices across incident, problem, and service request management.

  • Work closely with the Service Desk team to ensure proper documentation, knowledge sharing, and user guidance related to incidents and requests.

Standardization, Cost & Vendor Management

  • Identify opportunities for standardization, operational efficiency, and cost reduction.

  • Review reports related to hardware, peripherals, malfunctions, maintenance, and productivity impact to address recurring issues.

Technology Implementation & Global Collaboration

  • Assist global IT teams with the remediation and implementation of new technologies, systems, and devices.
  • Support the adoption and enforcement of corporate standards for hardware, software, applications, and IT security.
  • Collaborate with regional and global IT stakeholders to align local support activities with enterprise initiatives.

Compliance & Governance

Qualifications & Experience

Required Qualifications

title: Consultor de Hidráulica (Industrial Celulose)
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Desafio:

Atuar como referência técnica e consultiva em nossos sistemas hidráulicos industriais, garantindo a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e eficiência dos equipamentos utilizados no processo produtivo. Prover suporte avançado para equipes de manutenção, engenharia de confiabilidade e operação, orientando diagnósticos, melhorias e a implementação de soluções hidráulicas de alta robustez.

Atividades Principais:

  • Gerenciar a equipe de técnicos de manutenção hidráulica, assegurando que a equipe seja treinada e qualificada para realizar manutenções complexas, utilizando ferramentas e técnicas adequadas, assim como, distribuindo tarefas de acordo com as prioridades de manutenção, garantindo que os recursos sejam alocados de forma eficiente e assegurando que os colaboradores sigam normas e regulamentos de segurança, como o uso de EPI (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual);
  • Realizar diagnósticos e manutenções detalhadas e troubleshooting em sistemas hidráulicos presentes nas principais áreas operacionais da planta;
  • Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho de equipamentos hidráulicos de alta criticidade;
  • Gerir o time nas atividades de reparo durante as paradas, assegurando que todas as equipes estejam sincronizadas e que os materiais e peças de reposição estejam disponíveis, monitorando o cumprimento dos cronogramas e tomando medidas corretivas em caso de atrasos ou desvios no planejamento;
  • Desenvolver e revisar planos de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e inspeções aplicados às rotinas da planta;
  • Elaborar pareceres técnicos, instruções de trabalho, procedimentos e padrões de montagem/ajuste específicos para a unidade;
  • Documentar detalhadamente os estudos de falhas, as lições aprendidas e as soluções implementadas, criando um banco de dados de conhecimento que sirva de referência para futuras análises e treinamentos, garantindo que o aprendizado seja capitalizado pela organização;
  • Pesquisar e analisar a viabilidade de implementação de novas tecnologias e metodologias aplicados nas reformas de manutenção em oficina que possam aumentar a confiabilidade e a eficiência dos equipamentos;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Suprimentos e Engenharia de Confiabilidade para avaliar o desempenho de componentes críticos e propor a padronização ou substituição por outros de maior durabilidade e confiabilidade, baseando-se em análises técnicas e de custo-benefício;
  • Desenvolver e ministrar programas de treinamento e workshops para o time de manutenção hidráulica, elevando o nível técnico e a capacidade de diagnóstico;
  • Realizar pesquisas de benchmarking com outras empresas ou indústrias de equivalente para identificar as melhores práticas em manutenção mecânica e propor a sua adaptação e implementação na fábrica;
  • Colaborar com a Engenharia de Confiabilidade na análise do ciclo de vida de equipamentos, fornecendo insights técnicos sobre a viabilidade de reformas vs. substituições, considerando custos de manutenção acumulados, criticidade e tecnologias disponíveis;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o Almoxarifado e Suprimentos para otimizar o estoque de sobressalentes de componentes hidráulicos, garantindo a disponibilidade de itens críticos sem incorrer em custos excessivos de capital parado;
  • Auxiliar na gestão dos custos da função Hidráulica, realizando a previsão do orçamento anual de (Spend e Headcount), incluindo custos de peças, mão de obra e outros recursos, assim como, acompanhar mensalmente os custos realizados, alocando corretamente nas contas contábeis, apresentando e validando com o gestor imediato durante as reuniões de análise crítica, visando o cumprimento do orçamento e otimização dos custos;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com o time de engenharia, produção e segurança, apoiando e executando projetos de melhorias, inovação, modificações e modernização de instalações, máquinas e equipamentos, normas e planos de manutenção, identificando causa raiz, apresentando soluções corretivas e preventivas, evitando recorrências, otimizando custos e aumentando a disponibilidade das máquinas e equipamentos;
  • Treinar e orientar tecnicamente os times de manutenção, nos procedimentos e melhores práticas, promovendo a melhoria contínua das habilidades e conhecimento, bem como, assegurando que o time esteja treinado e capacitado para assumir as atividades de manutenção após o startup da planta, disponibilizando ferramentas, recursos técnicos e humanos para apoiar os fornecedores dos equipamentos e tecnologias;
  • Elaborar escopos de contratação de serviços terceirizados de manutenção, participando ativamente das etapas de negociação e avaliação técnica, assegurando as melhores práticas, custos adequados, qualidade, segurança e a confiabilidade em todo o processo;
  • Participar ativamente do processo de planejamento e execução da Parada Geral da planta, realizando o mapeamento das atividades de manutenção, através de alinhamento com a gerência de produção, mitigando os riscos e impactos gerados, desenvolvendo estratégias e plano de ação, avaliando e desenvolvendo fornecedores e prestadores de serviço, sempre prezando pela segurança e otimização dos custos;
  • Implantar, monitorar e analisar diariamente os indicadores de desempenho da sua área de atuação (Custos, disponibilidade, produtividade, estoque de peças de reposição etc.), viabilizando ajustes no planejamento, procedimentos e nos processos;
  • Cumprir, fazer cumprir e promover os padrões de segurança e regulamentações aplicadas às pessoas e aos equipamentos, através da realização de avaliação de riscos e implantação de medidas, alinhas à gestão;
  • Zelar pela organização e limpeza das áreas de atuação utilizando ferramentas como 5S garantindo que todo o processo seja implementado, conhecido e aplicado pelo time de manutenção;
  • Garantir que as atividades de manutenção estejam alinhadas aos objetivos e requisitos da área cliente, através de alinhamento e interação com a área demandante, para entendimento da necessidade e expectativa de prazos e qualidade da entrega;
  • Outras atividades correlatas;

Requisitos

  • Curso superior completo em Engenharias e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Especialização em Manutenção Industrial, Gestão de Projetos, Lean Manufacturing e afins será um diferencial;
  • Domínio de técnicas e ferramentas de análise de falhas (Root Cause Analysis - RCA, 5 Porquês, Diagrama de Ishikawa), com capacidade de identificar causas-raiz e propor soluções eficazes;
  • Técnicas de manutenção preditiva (análise de vibração, termografia, ultrassom, análise de óleo) e planejamento de manutenção preventiva;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas hidráulicos Bosch Rexroth (Hägglunds).

title: Senior Payments Manager - Brazil
description:

Payment performance & operations

New payment method onboarding

Cross-functional collaboration

Regulatory awareness

Market intelligence

  • 5–8 years in payments, financial institutions partnerships, or payment operations within a fintech, bank, acquirer, payment processor, or global payments company — with a strong focus on the Brazilian market.

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience at a global payments company, international acquirer, or cross-border payment platform operating in Brazil.

  • Familiarity with API-based payment integrations and the technical fundamentals of payment processing.
  • A practical approach to AI tools — using them to automate routine tasks, accelerate analysis, and improve the quality and efficiency of your own work output.
  • MBA or advanced degree in Business, Finance, or a related field.
  • Mandarin is a strong plus.

About Antom

Antom is a leading merchant payment and digitisation services provider under Ant International. We help global merchants and partners accept digital payments, scale their businesses across borders, and deliver seamless checkout experiences to consumers worldwide. In Brazil, we are investing in the local payments ecosystem to become the infrastructure layer of choice for merchants operating in or into the market.

title: Oracle EPM Technical Consultant
description:
We are looking for an experienced Oracle Cloud EPM Technical Consultant to design, develop, integrate, and support Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) Cloud solutions.

The role involves working closely with functional consultants and business stakeholders to deliver technical solutions using EPM integrations, business rules, data management, reporting tools, and automation frameworks .

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Oracle EPM Cloud technical tools and architecture , along with proven experience delivering end-to-end implementations and post-production support .

️ Key Responsibilities

Technical Development & Configuration

Develop and maintain:

  • Business Rules / Calculation Scripts
  • Data Management & Data Integration processes
  • Metadata management and dimension hierarchies
  • Automation scripts and technical frameworks to improve delivery efficiency

Perform data loads, transformations, and migrations across environments .

Troubleshoot production issues and provide root cause analysis .

Integrations

Design and implement integrations using:

  • EPM Data Integration / Data Management
  • REST APIs
  • Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
  • SFTP-based inbound/outbound interfaces

Integrate EPM with ERP systems (Oracle ERP, SAP, or other financial systems) .

Monitor, debug, and optimize integrations.

Reporting & Analytics

Develop operational and financial reports using:

  • Smart View
  • Financial Reporting
  • Management Reporting
  • Ad-hoc reporting tools

Ensure data accuracy, reporting performance, and consistency across financial reports .

Security & Data Management

Configure and troubleshoot:

  • Access roles and security groups
  • User provisioning
  • Application security settings

Ensure data governance, financial control, and compliance standards .

Implementation & Support

Participate in:

  • Requirement analysis
  • Technical design
  • Build, testing, and deployment
  • Cutover and go-live support

Provide post-production support, issue resolution, and system enhancements .

Prepare technical documentation and knowledge transfer .

Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Functional consultants
  • Finance stakeholders
  • Project managers
  • Offshore/onshore teams

Mentor junior resources when required.

Required Skills & Experience

✅ Mandatory Skills

  • 6–8 years of IT experience with 4+ years in Oracle EPM Cloud technical roles
  • Strong hands-on expertise in:
  • Oracle EPM Planning / EPBCS / FCCS
  • Business Rules / Calculation Scripts
  • Data Integration / Data Management
  • Smart View and Financial Reporting
  • Experience integrating EPM with ERP systems
  • Experience in at least one full lifecycle Oracle EPM Cloud implementation
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills
  • SQL knowledge for data validation and analysis

⭐ Good to Have

Experience with:

  • Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
  • Financial Close and Consolidation (FCCS)
  • Enterprise Planning (EPBCS)
  • Financial data modeling and forecasting processes
  • Cloud infrastructure (OCI)

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description:
Note: This role is 100% remote, but we require overlap with Eastern Time (EST/EDT) working hours to ensure smooth collaboration with the team.

Company Introduction

NextDay AI is a privately held company specializing in applying artificial intelligence (AI) engineering and creative innovation in B2C entertainment products. Our mission is to leverage the power of Large Language Models (LLM) and generative AI (Gen AI) to create innovative consumer products that push the boundaries of entertainment and companionship. With over 35 millions+ messages per day and millions of monthly visitors, our products are revolutionizing the way people interact with AI.

This is a unique opportunity to participate and make a real difference in a company actively working to shape the future of AI applications for consumers.

Job Description

We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who can own and drive the frontend experience across our web and mobile products. We need someone who sees problems, proposes solutions, and ships them. You’ll be working across a modern React (web) and React Native (mobile) codebase, building features used by millions of users every day.

You’ll care deeply about code quality, maintainability, and performance - and you’ll champion the use of AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to move faster without sacrificing standards. You’re the kind of engineer who treats AI coding assistants as a force multiplier, not a crutch, and you’re always looking for ways to improve code quality and performance with these tools.

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role. You’ll collaborate closely with product, design, backend engineers, and QA - but at the end of the day, you’ll own your domain and be trusted to make the right calls.

What You’ll Do

  • Build, ship, and maintain high-quality features across our React web application and React Native mobile app, working across the full frontend surface area.
  • Take ownership of major frontend initiatives end-to-end - from technical design through implementation, testing, and deployment - without needing hand-holding.
  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable TypeScript code that other engineers can confidently build on. Champion code quality standards, review PRs thoroughly, and help to raise the bar for the whole team.
  • Actively leverage AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) and agentic workflows to accelerate development. Advocate for and help the team adopt best practices around AI-augmented engineering.
  • Collaborate with Product, Design, and QA to translate requirements into elegant, performant user experiences. Push back when something doesn’t make sense and propose better alternatives.
  • Improve our frontend architecture, patterns, and tooling. Identify technical debt and address it proactively - you don’t wait for permission to make things better.
  • Contribute to our shared business logic and component libraries, ensuring consistency across web and mobile platforms.
  • Mentor and support other engineers through code reviews, pairing sessions, and knowledge sharing. Lead by example.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional frontend engineering experience with a strong track record of shipping production software at scale.
  • Deep expertise in React and the modern React ecosystem (hooks, context, routing, state management). You don’t just use React - you understand it.
  • Solid experience with React Native or strong willingness to ramp up quickly. We need someone comfortable building across both web and mobile.
  • Advanced TypeScript proficiency. You write typed code by default and understand how to use the type system to prevent bugs and improve developer experience.
  • A genuine passion for clean, maintainable code. You care about naming things well, keeping components focused, writing meaningful tests, and leaving code better than you found it.
  • Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted development tools and a clear point of view on how to use them effectively. You’re a champion of agentic coding workflows and can show how you’ve used them to ship faster.
  • Self-directed and proactive. You take initiative, own your work fully, and don’t need to be managed closely. You see what needs doing and do it.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. You can articulate technical decisions clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, startup-like environment where priorities shift and ambiguity is the norm.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with our tech stack:
  • React 18, React Native, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, Vitest, React Testing Library, GitHub Actions, Yarn 4
  • Experience with real-time features (Socket.io, WebSockets) and streaming interfaces
  • Experience building and consuming shared component libraries or design systems
  • Familiarity with feature flag systems (GrowthBook or similar) and progressive rollout strategies
  • Background in B2C consumer products with high traffic and millions of daily active users
  • Experience with PWA architecture, service workers, and offline-first patterns
  • Familiarity with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence)
  • Interest or experience in AI/LLM products and conversational interfaces

Why join us?

  • Real 100% remote work (we don't have physical offices to go to "once per week")
  • Flex-time / Manage your schedule Policy (we are looking for teamwork and results, not hours)
  • Unlimited Vacations Policy
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • A dynamic and supportive work environment.

If you're passionate about AI and innovation and want to be at the forefront of the conversational AI revolution and join a team on the first few years of a great journey, apply today! We might have a seat for you on our rocketship!

title: Engenheiro(a) de Integração de Software Veicular
description:
SOBRE A VAGA:

ATIVIDADE: Implementação, integração e troubleshooting de software embarcado veicular , com atuação direta em caminhões e sistemas eletroeletrônicos automotivos.

RESUMO

O profissional selecionado atuará no time de Engenharia de Implementação de Software Veicular , em um ambiente industrial e altamente técnico, com foco na integração, validação e diagnóstico de software embarcado em caminhões .

A posição envolve atuação hands-on diretamente nos veículos , garantindo a correta implementação de software, análise de falhas, troubleshooting avançado e conformidade eletroeletrônica para liberação dos caminhões para rodagem.

O trabalho acontece em um contexto global e multifuncional , com interação constante com times de desenvolvimento de software, hardware e engenharia internacional, seguindo metodologia Agile / SCRUM .

FORMAÇÃO

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica, Automação ou áreas correlatas.

AMBIENTE DE TRABALHO

  • Engenharia de Produto / Implementação de Software
  • Atuação presencial em planta industrial
  • Projetos automotivos com interação global

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Realizar implementação e download de software embarcado em caminhões;
  • Atuar diretamente nos veículos realizando software breakdown, checks elétricos e eletrônicos e troubleshooting ;
  • Conduzir análises de causa raiz (root cause analysis) e resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Coletar, analisar e interpretar logs, DTCs, parâmetros e baselines de software;
  • Analisar diagramas elétricos automotivos e arquitetura eletroeletrônica dos veículos;
  • Trabalhar com diferentes arquiteturas e classes de caminhões;
  • Interface contínua com equipes de desenvolvimento de software e hardware, garantindo a conformidade do veículo;
  • Planejar e registrar atividades técnicas (relatórios, JIRA, documentação técnica);
  • Apoiar a preparação dos veículos para testes e liberação para rodagem em via pública.

REQUISITOS

  • Experiência prática com software embarcado automotivo ;
  • Vivência com implementação, integração ou validação de software veicular (não P&D);
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura elétrica e eletrônica automotiva (ECUs, redes veiculares);
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de diagramas elétricos automotivos ;
  • Conhecimento de protocolos automotivos: CAN, CAN FD, LIN e Ethernet ;
  • Experiência com troubleshooting e diagnóstico em veículos ou sistemas automotivos;
  • Perfil hands-on , analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas;
  • Conhecimento em metodologia Agile / SCRUM (JIRA como diferencial);
  • Pacote Office intermediário;
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação com times globais;
  • CNH C ou D (CNH E é diferencial).

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Experiência prévia em ambiente automotivo pesado (caminhões, ônibus, máquinas);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de diagnóstico e gestão de software automotivo, como:
  • CANalyzer (Vector);
  • EDB, SW Configurator;
  • Tech Tool / GDSP;
  • Vivência em ambientes industriais e projetos globais;
  • Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica em troubleshooting.

IDIOMAS

  • Inglês avançado – mandatório .

PERFIL

  • Profissional com forte atuação prática e presença em campo;
  • Capaz de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes nacionais e internacionais;
  • Confortável com ambiente industrial, pressão técnica e resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Boa comunicação, organização e autonomia para lidar com múltiplas demandas.

CARGO

Analista de Implementação de Software Veicular

CONTRATAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS

  • Contrato CLT;
  • Refeição no local;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Horário: 2ª a 6ª das 08:00 às 17:15 (100% presencial);

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint

Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.

About the Role

The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura de TI
description:
VAGA | ESPECIALISTA EM INFRAESTRUTURA DE TI

A G4F é uma empresa com uma trajetória sólida de 16 anos, dedicada a conectar pessoas, ideias e tecnologia para oferecer soluções inovadoras. Somos mais de 10.000 #greaters atuando em todo o Brasil.

Missão do cargo

Atuar no planejamento, implementação, sustentação e evolução da infraestrutura de TI, garantindo alta disponibilidade, desempenho, segurança e confiabilidade dos ambientes tecnológicos. O profissional será responsável por suportar e otimizar ambientes de data center, virtualização, redes e nuvem, assegurando a continuidade dos serviços corporativos e aderência às melhores práticas de mercado.

Principais atribuições

  • Realizar suporte e manutenção de servidores e data center, planejando capacidade e desenvolvendo projetos de melhoria dos serviços corporativos.
  • Criar e administrar usuários e grupos, garantindo a concessão adequada de privilégios e permissões de acesso.
  • Implantar servidores físicos e virtuais, incluindo configuração de clusters para alta disponibilidade, assegurando o cumprimento das políticas de recursos computacionais.
  • Elaborar e manter documentação de procedimentos operacionais.
  • Atuar no gerenciamento de todos os componentes de um Data Center (hardware, software, pessoas e redes), bem como em questões relacionadas a SLA, camadas e Tiers de Data Centers.
  • Trabalhar com diferentes técnicas de virtualização de servidores, compreendendo seus benefícios e principais fornecedores.
  • Atuar com virtualização de aplicações.
  • Administrar e suportar ambientes de nuvem privada, pública e híbrida, bem como seus modelos (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS).
  • Atuar com infraestrutura cabeada (par trançado e fibra óptica), wireless e roteamento, essenciais para ambientes corporativos.
  • Implementar sistemas e estratégias de prevenção contra falhas e ameaças de segurança (crackers e hackers).
  • Atuar com tecnologias relacionadas a Big Data, Analytics, Data Science e Machine Learning, no contexto de infraestrutura.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação em curso de nível superior na área de Tecnologia da Informação; ou
  • Conclusão de qualquer curso de nível superior, acompanhada de pós-graduação (especialização, mestrado ou doutorado) na área de Tecnologia da Informação, com carga mínima de 360 horas, em instituição reconhecida pelo MEC.

Experiência Profissional

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à Infraestrutura de TI, comprovada por documento expedido por pessoa jurídica de direito público ou privado.

Certificações Obrigatórias

O profissional deverá possuir, no mínimo, 2 (duas) das certificações abaixo (ou equivalentes/superiores):

  • CISSP – Certified Information Systems Security Professional
  • CCIE – Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert
  • MCSE – Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert
  • CCIE Security Certification and Training
  • LPIC‑3 300 – Linux Enterprise Professional

✅ Conhecimentos Técnicos Esperados

  • Infraestrutura de servidores e data center.

title: User Insights Specialist
description:
Role Overview

The User Insights Specialist will be responsible for analyzing user behavior, identifying experience gaps, and generating insights that inform product, operations, and growth strategies.

This role combines data analytics, user research, and business understanding , requiring strong SQL capabilities and the ability to communicate insights effectively to cross-functional stakeholders.

This position requires full on-site presence (5 days per week) to enable close collaboration with Product, Operations, and Business teams.

Key Responsibilities

User Insights & Analysis

  • Analyze user behavior, engagement trends, and operational data to identify opportunities to improve user experience and retention.
  • Translate complex datasets into actionable insights supporting product and business decision-making.
  • Monitor key user metrics and proactively identify risks, friction points, and growth opportunities.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets using SQL .
  • Build dashboards, recurring reports, and insight frameworks to track user experience performance.
  • Partner with Data, Product, and Operations teams to define and monitor KPIs related to user satisfaction and platform performance.

User Research & Feedback Integration

  • Consolidate quantitative data with qualitative user feedback (surveys, interviews, support data, NPS).
  • Identify root causes behind user pain points and behavioral patterns.
  • Support experimentation initiatives by measuring impact and validating hypotheses.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Operations, Customer Experience, and Growth teams to influence strategic decisions.
  • Present insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Drive a data-informed culture by promoting user-centric decision-making.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Economics, Statistics, or related field.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis.
  • Professional fluency in English and Portuguese (written and spoken).
  • Experience working with data analytics, user insights, product analytics, or business intelligence.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to translate data into clear business recommendations.
  • Willingness to work on-site in the office 5 days per week .
